run_metadata.coverage_summary: Network constraint unchanged from the 2026-10-05 onward runs and re-verified this run: the environment's egress proxy denies ALL outbound HTTPS to external hosts. Both WebFetch (DNS ENOTFOUND) and a direct curl test returned 403 CONNECT-tunnel denials for www.tenders.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au AND example.com, and the proxy status endpoint logged each as 'connect_rejected / gateway answered 403 (policy denial)'. So the block is a global network-policy denial, not a domain or tool issue, and cannot be worked around. Consequently NO tender detail page or specification document could be opened; EVERY recorded opportunity is headline-level only (all counted in entries_pending_detail) with no deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria/documents extraction. Only WebSearch (routed through Anthropic infrastructure, not the egress proxy) was available; it is US-indexed and lags the live Australian portals, so most Tier 1 portal queries returned stale/closed cached listings (e.g. City of Perth RFT000300/RFT000301 already closed 8-13 Oct) or non-Australian noise (Ariba queries surfaced CanadaBuys). Within that limit this run found one genuinely new, currently-open and closing-soon Commonwealth opportunity (Capacity Investment Scheme Tender 11 for ~1.8 GW of WA renewables, bidding 27 Aug - 22 Oct 2026), re-confirmed the ACT Aquatic Strategy consultancy still open (closing 27 Oct 2026, carried forward from 2026-10-12), and carried forward the two 2026-10-14 items (ABF Ship's Boats; Ron Barwick Prison, both closing 17 Nov 2026) without being able to re-verify them on their primary portals. Tier 3 (mandatory) was checked - SAP Ariba / SAP Business Network Discovery and major-buyer portals expose no publicly-visible Australian RFx this run (all opportunity detail is login-gated); their portals remain recorded in discovered_sources. Source discovery: four genuinely new buyer-originated sources identified - Mount Alexander Shire Council (VIC, new VendorPanel portal going live in coming months), Narrabri Shire Council (NSW), Gwydir Shire Council (NSW), and the DCCEEW Capacity Investment Scheme tender channel.
gaps: EGRESS POLICY BLOCK (global): the environment network policy denies all outbound HTTPS to external hosts. WebFetch fails with DNS ENOTFOUND and direct curl returns HTTP 403 'CONNECT tunnel failed' for every external host tested, including example.com, www.tenders.gov.au and www.vendorpanel.com.au. Proxy status endpoint confirmed 'connect_rejected / gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial)'. Not retried per proxy guidance.

No tender detail pages or specification/request documents could be opened on ANY portal, so all four recorded opportunities are headline-level only (deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, contacts, exact closing times could not be extracted from primary sources).

WebSearch (the only working tool) is US-indexed and lags live Australian portals; Tier 1 portal live listings (AusTender, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, QTOL NT, Tenders ACT) could not be queried directly and mostly returned stale or already-closed cached rows.

Capacity Investment Scheme Tender 11 close date (22 Oct 2026) is sourced from trade-press coverage (pv-magazine, esdnews, enerdata, taiyangnews, reneweconomy) citing DCCEEW/the minister; the official DCCEEW CIS tender page could not be reached to confirm the exact close time, submission mechanics or documents.

Carried-forward items 'Provision of Ship's Boats to the Australian Border Force' (AusTender) and 'Ron Barwick Minimum Security Prison amenities upgrade' (Tasmania Dept of Justice) were first recorded 2026-10-14 from aggregator snippets and could NOT be re-verified on their primary portals this run; retained with original first_seen and flagged unconfirmed.

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery and major-buyer portals (BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, Santos, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, Telstra, banks) exposed no publicly-visible Australian RFx via search; individual opportunities are registration-gated or invitation-only and were not captured as tenders (portals recorded in discovered_sources only).
Local-government sample this run was NSW/VIC VendorPanel-migrating councils; many councils, universities, TAFEs, health districts, and GBEs were not sampled and are deferred to future runs.
recommended_seed_additions: DCCEEW Capacity Investment Scheme (CIS) tender channel - recurring high-value Commonwealth renewables/storage tenders (Tender 11 WA open now); worth monitoring the DCCEEW CIS page and AEMO Services as a standing source.
Mount Alexander Shire Council (VIC) - new VendorPanel procurement portal going live in coming months.
Narrabri Shire Council (NSW) - buyer-originated tenders/quotations/EOI page.
Gwydir Shire Council (NSW) - buyer-originated Request for Tenders/Quotes page.

A rotating weekly sweep of the ~councils publicly announcing TenderLink-to-VendorPanel migrations in 2025-2026 (East Gippsland, Forbes, Mount Alexander, Temora, Camden) to catch newly-advertised RFx as they switch platforms.

tenders.title: Capacity Investment Scheme Tender 11 - ~1.8 GW renewable generation (WA Wholesale Electricity Market)
tenders.buyer: Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water (DCCEEW)
tenders.category: Renewable energy generation capacity (wind/solar) under the Capacity Investment Scheme
tenders.description: Commonwealth competitive tender under the Capacity Investment Scheme seeking approximately 1.8 GW of new renewable generation in the Western Australian Wholesale Electricity Market (WEM), with projects expected to be operating by 2030. Bidding opened 27 August 2026 and is reported to close 22 October 2026, with successful bids announced March 2027.
tenders.eligibility: Reported to require participation in the independently-run Developer Rating Scheme (Equifax) - developers must have commenced DRS assessment to bid; projects must participate in WA's Reserve Capacity Mechanism. Full eligibility not verifiable (official DCCEEW page unreachable this run).
mandatory_conditions: Reported: participation in the Developer Rating Scheme (run by Equifax) required to bid
Reported: projects must participate in WA's Reserve Capacity Mechanism
Reported: includes a 180 MW First Nations Equity and Revenue Sharing Set Aside (>=5% First Nations equity or equivalent revenue-sharing)
tenders.reasoning: Surfaced via WebSearch news coverage (pv-magazine-australia, esdnews.com.au, enerdata.net, taiyangnews.info, reneweconomy.com.au) of a DCCEEW-run Capacity Investment Scheme tender round; buyer-originated Commonwealth procurement channel (DCCEEW CIS). Primary DCCEEW CIS page could not be opened due to the egress-policy block.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only - no primary tender page or documents reachable (egress block). Close date 22 Oct 2026 and all design details (DRS requirement, First Nations set-aside, RCM participation, 2030 COD) are from trade-press coverage citing DCCEEW/the minister and remain to be confirmed on the official DCCEEW CIS page / AEMO Services tender documents. tender_url, submission mechanics, value and contacts not published in reachable sources.

tenders.description: ACT Government is engaging a consultant to lead development of a 10-year ACT Aquatic Strategy covering the Territory's aquatic facility needs, required investment and locations, including assessment of potential to attract and host state, national and international aquatic events in Canberra. A draft is expected for public release in Q1 2027.
